title: The Valhalla Call
author: Evan Currie
note: conf=0.95; Goodreads lists it as "The Valhalla Call (Hayden War Cycle, #4)". Publisher blurb (AbeBooks/LibraryThing) states it is "book four of the Hayden's War Arc of the Warrior's Wings series" — the series was rebranded "Warrior's Wings" (also listed by some retailers as "On Silver Wings, 4") on later 47North editions, matching the EPUB metadata "The Valhalla Call (Warrior's Wings)". It concludes the Hayden War arc begun in On Silver Wings. Author metadata "Currie" = Evan Currie.
